Method of Attack: Malicious VBS attachments embedded in Microsoft OneNote files that launch scripts to download and install remote access trojans
Use of OneNote attachments in phishing emails to deliver malware
Remote access trojans install malware to steal files, passwords, screenshots, record webcam video, and steal cryptocurrency wallets
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Microsoft OneNote attachments containing VBS scripts
Indicators of Compromise: OneNote attachments with VBS scripts that download and execute malware
Malicious batch files executed in background
Fake DHL shipping notifications, invoices, ACH remittance forms, mechanical drawings, and shipping documents used as lures
